title: Epic
description: Optional container: one outcome delivered by several Specs. When two teams share it, the Epic context is their only shared glossary.

status.description: Optional: `done` or `cancelled` when a person closes or stops it; draft and active are derived from the children.

owner_team.description: The team accountable for the Epic's outcome. The Epic is multi-team when the Specs under it name two or more `owner_team`s.

context.description: Shared terms and constraints for every Spec under this Epic.

covers.description: The ids of the proposal needs this Epic delivers, when it came from an accepted proposal.
